_comment: BearBrowser extension registry. Disposition for every evaluated extension. 'native' = capability already built into BearBrowser. 'allowlist' = safe to unseal for human-secure. 'blocked' = unconditionally blocked. 'review' = not yet evaluated.

extensions.name: uBlock Origin
extensions.rationale: Full native replacement with tighter integration. Extension surface eliminated.

extensions.name: Adblock Plus
extensions.rationale: Same engine (adblock-rust), worse integration. Replaced natively.

extensions.name: Privacy Badger
extensions.native_replacement: ETP strict mode + BearBlocker privacy filter list
extensions.rationale: Heuristic tracker blocking covered by Firefox ETP strict + our curated lists.

extensions.name: HTTPS Everywhere
extensions.rationale: Firefox native HTTPS-only mode is more complete than the extension.

extensions.name: Video DownloadHelper
extensions.rationale: Legitimate use case, no telemetry. Requires explicit unseal per-session.

extensions.name: Bitwarden
extensions.rationale: Open-source, self-hostable. No external telemetry if self-hosted. Acceptable for human-secure with explicit unseal. Never for agent-runtime.

extensions.name: React Developer Tools
extensions.rationale: Dev-only, no network activity. Safe to unseal during development sessions.

extensions.name: Vimium C
extensions.rationale: Keyboard nav only, no network requests, open source. No meaningful attack surface.

extensions.name: Tree Style Tab
extensions.rationale: UI-only, no telemetry. Acceptable for power users who explicitly unseal.

extensions.name: Zotero Connector
extensions.rationale: Research tool, communicates only with local Zotero app on 127.0.0.1. Safe to unseal.

extensions.name: Grammarly
extensions.rationale: Exfiltrates all typed text to Grammarly servers. Incompatible with privacy model. No unseal path.

extensions.name: Honey (PayPal)
extensions.rationale: Affiliate tracking, purchase surveillance, sends browsing data to PayPal. Unconditionally blocked.

extensions.name: Capital One Shopping
extensions.rationale: Same class as Honey. Affiliate and purchase surveillance.

extensions.name: SaveFrom.net Helper
extensions.rationale: Known malvertising vector. Injects scripts, monetizes downloads. Unconditionally blocked.

extensions.name: Avast Online Security
extensions.rationale: Avast has a documented history of selling browsing data. Blocked regardless of claimed functionality.

extensions.name: AVG Online Security
extensions.rationale: Same as Avast (same company, same data practices).

extensions.name: LastPass
extensions.rationale: Multiple breaches. Sends vault metadata to LastPass servers. Replaced by Bitwarden (manual-unseal) or desktop credential manager.

extensions.name: Ghostery
extensions.rationale: Historical data-sharing practices. Native BearBlocker covers the blocking use case without the extension surface.

extensions.name: Dark Reader
extensions.rationale: OS dark mode propagates through Firefox natively. For sites that don't respect it, add userContent.css rules.

extensions.name: SearchPreview
extensions.rationale: Sends search queries to SearchPreview servers for thumbnail generation.

extensions.name: Disconnect
extensions.native_replacement: ETP strict mode uses Disconnect tracker lists natively
extensions.rationale: Firefox ETP strict ships the Disconnect list. Extension is redundant.

extensions.name: YouTube High Definition
extensions.rationale: No external calls, UI quality-of-life. Low risk.

extensions.name: SponsorBlock
extensions.rationale: Sends hashed video IDs to SponsorBlock API (no PII). Legitimate use case. Note: segments data is community-contributed, open-source backend.

extensions.name: User-Agent Switcher and Manager
extensions.rationale: Overrides RFP-managed UA string. Undermines fingerprint resistance. BearBrowser manages UA via prefs.

extensions.name: Tampermonkey
extensions.rationale: Userscript injection surface. Could be allowlisted for power users with audited scripts. Needs explicit policy decision — not currently approved.

extensions.name: Violentmonkey
extensions.rationale: Open-source Tampermonkey alternative. Same risk profile. Pending explicit policy decision.
